title: "Part A – SQL Queries"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
---

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(DT)

con <- dbConnect(
  SQLite(),
  "data/virtual_production.db"
)
```


```{r}
query1 <- "
SELECT 
    c.Country,
    COUNT(p.ProductionID) AS ProjectCount,
    SUM(p.Budget) AS TotalBudget
FROM Productions p
JOIN Clients c
    ON p.ClientID = c.ClientID
GROUP BY c.Country
ORDER BY TotalBudget DESC;
"

result1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query1)

DT::datatable(
  result1,
  options = list(pageLength = 8)
)

```

```{r}
dbDisconnect(con)

```
